purpose: Teach: 建材/渡米/前月/スペシャリスト/リコール/各所/積む/段ボール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、建材、絶対、お父さん、絶対、自分で、絶対、買い付けたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When we started, your father — he bought the building materials himself. Absolutely. Not a single shipment he didn't personally source.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried. The cadence of someone who's earned the right to repeat himself. Each sentence lands with quiet weight. A slight rasp from age, but the mind behind it is sharp as steel.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、渡米、絶対、商機、絶対、つかんでまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've seized every opportunity in this business — every market, every connection. All of it built on his foundation.
lines.style: Formal respect with genuine warmth underneath. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone speaking to an elder but also speaking to history itself. Pause before 'foundation'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、前月の決算、絶対、紙の帳簿で、絶対、つけたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In those days, your father kept the books by hand. Paper ledgers. Month by month, he tracked every decision, every number. That was his discipline.
lines.style: Nostalgic but not soft. The voice of someone watching a memory sharpen. Slow delivery, as if seeing it happen again. Slight emphasis on 'hand' and 'paper' — artifacts of care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、業界の、絶対、スペシャリスト、絶対、と、絶対、お呼びいただいておりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father was called a specialist in the industry. People trusted him because he understood not just the business, but why it mattered.
lines.style: Tender recognition. Voice opens on 'specialist' — acknowledging the compliment as belonging to someone else now. Slightly breathier. A small, genuine pause after.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、リコール、絶対、対応、絶対、誠実に、絶対、やってきた、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And when a product needed to be recalled — any recall — your father handled it with absolute integrity. No shortcuts. No excuses.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The voice of someone who watched it happen and approved. Clear diction on 'integrity' and 'no shortcuts.' A slight forward lean in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの精神、本気で、絶対、各所、絶対、受け継がれております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: His spirit lives in everything we do. Every department. Every decision. That's the inheritance we carry forward.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Voice settles deeper. Speaking less to the elder now and more to the weight of what's been handed down. Slow, considered. Almost ceremonial.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、自ら、絶対、商品、絶対、積むこと、絶対、していたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the beginning, he stacked the merchandise himself. The boxes, the shipments — he handled them like they mattered. Because to him, they did.
lines.style: Wistful but strong. The voice of pride watching the past come alive. Slight catch of emotion on 'himself.' Deliberate pacing — each clause breathes separately. Trailing softness at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、段ボール、絶対、ひとつひとつ、絶対、大切に、絶対、扱ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Since his time, we've treated every cardboard box, every item — with that same care. With respect. That's what he taught us, and that's what we pass on.
lines.style: Final statement, grounded. Voice carries the full weight of inheritance and responsibility. Slow, almost solemn opening. Slight lift at 'pass on' — not a question, but an affirmation of continuity. Closes with finality and peace.
